summary.headline: Astrological Beginnings and Questions
summary.text: Catalog entries for codex 2 covering lunar eclipses, planetary effects by zodiac sign, co-rising stars, various beginnings and questions about illness, conception, nodes, places, luminaries, letters, death, robbers, and omens, with folio references and parallels to Florentine codices. The list ends with entries on the form, conjecture, tabular synopsis, universals, and approval of a beginning.
